scope: Real full tick; native Canvas and browser DOM stubbed; frames of 1/64 s; a desk of 1440×900 (the stories at 1900×810); the worker of Wings headless thinking sixteen rehearsed frames a frame. With Yinyang's rules taken out and no budget, the tour and the chain through every page from every other are Cohort's, the world and every drawing command, frame by frame; with them in, every change that does not go from a page to a page is. The images swing round each other: at their closest they pass further apart, over their sizes, than on Cohort. On the chain and the tour nothing waits, nothing fractures, from each round that moved a cell the performance is that round's rehearsal of the move to the bit, every change has one pace, every page at rest is exact and every cell drawn its own colour; on the chain with Breathe at 40 nothing waits or fractures. With no worker the hive thinks on the page and plays what it rehearsed. A Cue story is Cohort's frame by frame; a Tell and a Tell II story run to their end and home without a fractured cell. Defects and the gallery's measures are reported against Cohort, and with Breathe at 40.
